_comment: Baseline not yet measured, and the app is `excluded` in app.json so the default run leaves it out. `ctadl index` on it had not finished after two hours (2.9 GB resident, one core pegged); a bare index with no model is just as slow, so the cost is the app, not the model. The empty baseline is the safe placeholder for whenever it does run: this app declares no isNegative findings, so it cannot fail on a false positive, and an empty matched list cannot regress. Whatever ctadl detects is reported as an improvement -- run it deliberately with `cargo xtask taintbench --apk remote_control_smack=<path>`, give it the time, and commit the IDs it prints. See ../../README.md.
